text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"Spare horseshoes, sports drink, icicle 
cooling spray, athletic tape."

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Is there anything else you would like me 
to purchase? Also, if you have any 
requests for snacks, just let me know.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Is something the matter, Little Cocon?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Smooth communication between a Trainer and 
an Umamusume is an absolute necessity for 
achieving one's goals.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Anything is fine. Please, give me your 
candid opinion.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
"...Regarding snack requests, rather than 
store-bought items, umâ"

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Oh! You mean that protein banana cake 
Trainer Kashimoto baked for us the other 
day, right!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
She was saying in class yesterday just how 
delicious it was! I want to eat it again 
too!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
I-Idiot! Ah, sorry. Um, I just meant 
hypothetically—

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"...It is an exceptionally high-protein 
cake, after all. Let us prepare it first 
thing tomorrow."
